scope: A qualified occurrence denotes a general ingredient concept; no exact material, brand, concentration or clinical equivalence.
eligibility: All original pending/excluded mapping rows and all added contextual candidates are assessed.
Never override Low/excluded candidates or existing approved decisions.
Require explicit plant part and preparation, without conflicting or negated context.
Require an active RxNorm IN concept, equal explicit scope, and a saved exact RxNorm query-to-target result supporting the identity bridge.
Related query wording must have the same bounded ingredient family and supported qualifiers; its qualifiers must also equal target scope.
Only one eligible target per occurrence/source; competing accepted targets block automatic application.
Standardization percentages and named preparations stay on source occurrences and do not block a general concept link; never propagate them to the target.
PubChem structure identity, MeSH broader/narrower relations and NatMed subject mappings require separate rules and remain unchanged.
approval: User-authorized rule assessment, not individual human review or clinical approval.
